whatThisLaneIs: Border byte-accounting. It reads delivered bytes and asks one question of each family: does every flattened appearance that paints the page match a stream the pinned official source itself ships? It renders nothing and measures none of the nine counters.
whyItExists: Roger, 2026-09-10: new evidence about unchanged bytes can invalidate a prior approval, and substantiated failures are to be recorded through the existing verifier mechanism NOW rather than after repair.

reconciliation.note: The two sets are disjoint. Nothing here is double counted against the source-drift demotions, and the seventeen already off proven are not counted again.

rows.whyThePriorApprovalNoLongerHolds: The prior approval was granted without this question being asked. It is not withdrawn because the bytes changed -- they have not -- but because evidence now exists about those unchanged bytes that the approval never considered: the delivered artifact carries flattened widget appearances that paint the page and that match NO /AP /N stream in this family's own pinned sources, byte for byte.

whatWasMeasured.onWhat: every delivered fixture PDF of this family, at the digests committed at this base
whatWasMeasured.comparison: SHA-256 of the decompressed stream bytes, never shape, size or position, so a stream that merely resembles the form's own is not counted as the form's.

whatThisIsNotClaiming: NOT that the ink is synthesized from /MK. On co_petition_seal_arrest-set every one of its 36 unmatched streams turned out to be a source /AP stream minus its opaque background fill -- the form's own ink with one operator removed. Provenance is unaccounted for here; it is not established as invented.
NOT a visual-defect count. This is byte classification and no page was rendered for this row, which is why visualDefects is null rather than a number.

NOT a claim that the family is unrepairable, and not a statement about which remedy applies. The remedy differs by cause: ink invented from /MK is removed, ink that is the form's own must be restored.

countersHowMeasured.everyCounterIsNull: This row measures one thing and says so. None of the nine was measured here, so every one is null rather than 0. A published zero where no measurement was made is itself a defect class this factory has already recorded.

A family whose unaccounted streams are all shown to be the form's own ink, correctly placed, is cleared without a byte moving.
